name: Dreadforger [Combat]
body:
With a little extra effort, you can make your concoctions a lot more deadly.

Prerequisite(s): Craft (any) 5 ranks

Benefit(s): When creating a non-magical trap, item, or other device, you may increase the Craft DC to up to twice your character level. For every two points by which you increase the craft DC, the save DC of your creation increases by 1. Using this ability does not increase the cost of your creation.
